text: Over the past month have you avoided eating situations because you were worried something bad might happen, like being sick, choking, having an allergic reaction, or being in pain while eating (for example, because you might be served something you usually avoid for these reasons, or because you have had a bad experience in the past)? Indicate how often you have avoided eating situations due to such worries, ranging from 0 (= never) to 6 (= always).
